decision.reasoning_trace: I was looking for a reliable backpack for outdoor activities. My consideration set included a mix of hydration packs, a sling bag, a dry bag, and a cooler backpack. However, several products had concerning feedback regarding durability; for example, the Gelindo (078) had a review mentioning repairs were needed after a single hike, and the N NEVO RHINO (150) had reports of bladder failure. The rest of the feed was cluttered with miscategorized items like sleeping pads, camping food, and clothing. Because the most relevant backpacks had quality red flags and the others were too niche for my needs, I decided not to make a purchase.
